prompt: Look up a user's nickname in a map and return it as an Optional, treating missing keys and blank values as empty.
explanation: Optional.ofNullable turns Map.get's null-for-missing convention into an empty Optional, and filter empties the Optional again when the contained value fails a test -- here, String.isBlank. Chaining the two keeps the whole lookup null-safe without a single if statement.
hints: Map.get returns null for a missing key -- wrap the call: java.util.Optional.ofNullable(nicks.get(user)).
Chain .filter(s -> !s.isBlank()) so empty and whitespace-only values become Optional.empty().
